behaviour.text: Replaces the dnd5e character sheet entirely: one window holds vitals, abilities, skills, equipment with the paperdoll, spells, features and notes.
Opens instead of the dnd5e sheet for character actors; the dnd5e sheet stays reachable from the window menu.

Picks its layout from its own width, never the screen: under 420 px compact (rail only), 420–759 px narrow (rail becomes a sideways widget strip), 760–1319 px standard (rail + content), 1320 px and wider (rail + content + inspector).
When the layout changes, every block glides from its old place to its new one (FLIP, 420 ms settle curve) instead of jumping; blocks that appear fade and scale in from 92%.
The window is resizable from its corner; the minimum is 300 × 520 px.
Observer sees the same window with every control that changes data hidden or disabled and a «Только просмотр» badge; Owner and GM can change everything.
With motion off in settings or prefers-reduced-motion, every transition and animation is instant; nothing else changes.
Theme tokens live on this root element, never on :root.
The GM gets no separate GM toolbar; GM-only controls live where they act (the HP bar and its steps, the doll preset).
Controls answer the pointer: cards and buttons light up under the cursor, presses send a ripple from the pointer, buttons and slots lift on hover.
Rows show an accent edge on hover; their tile lifts and a sheen sweeps across it.
Tabs preview their underline on hover.
Starring an entry and casting a spell throw sparks: amber for the star, the spell school colour for a cast.
All of these stop when motion is off or the system asks for reduced motion.
On open the window settles in from 12 px below and the rail blocks follow one after another.
Switching tabs and expanding a section bring their entries in as a short cascade, 18 ms apart, at most 24 entries.
A new accent flows through every colour over 600 ms; a theme change cross-fades the whole sheet.
Hovering an entry in the icons-only view, a filled doll slot or an attunement socket for 320 ms shows a card with its tile, name, rarity or circle and description.
Scrollbars are styled: slim rounded thumbs on a clear track, accent while hovered or dragged; the tab strip shows none.
Once a panel is scrolled, the tab strip casts a soft shadow over it.
Always shows HP, hit dice, spell slots, AC, initiative, speed, proficiency, inspiration, exhaustion, concentration and favorites; each block except HP can be hidden in settings.
In the compact layout the rail is the whole window and also shows the portrait, name and an expand button.

In the narrow layout the rail becomes one row of fixed-width widgets (HP, hit dice and slots, rest, stats, spellcasting, effects, chips) that scrolls sideways and snaps; favorites and the portrait hide.

The owner and the GM change HP; observers cannot. Click turns the number into a field: −7 deals damage, +5 heals, a bare number sets HP, в8 grants temporary HP; Enter applies, Esc or leaving the field cancels. Damage and healing go through actor.applyDamage, temporary HP through actor.applyTempHP (the higher value stays). The number counts to its new value over 420 ms.

While typing, the result is drawn on the bar as a hatched band: red for damage, after temporary HP absorb their share, green for healing. An entry that cannot be read outlines the field red; a hint under the bar lists the entry forms.
Right click opens the field already holding в, for temporary HP.
On damage the red fill shrinks at once while a pale ghost of the old value stays for 380 ms, then drains to the new value over 700 ms; the bar shakes once.
On a heal the fill grows over 420 ms and the bar gives off a green glow; the ghost follows at once.
Damage takes temporary HP first; temporary HP shows as a striped blue band over the end of the fill and as +N beside the number.
At 0 HP the death saves block appears under the bar; healing above 0 hides it and clears both counters.
Under the bar a line shows max HP, temporary HP and the missing amount.
Rests still restore HP through the dnd5e rest rules, whoever starts the rest.
The HP bar is always alive: a highlight flows along the fill and the fill beats like a heart.
The heartbeat quickens as HP falls: 2.8 s above half, 1.7 s at half or below, 0.85 s at a quarter or below.
Each HP change floats a number over the value: red −N for damage, green +N for healing, blue −N врем. for temporary HP lost first.
At minimum HP the sheet reacts: from a quarter of max HP the window edge glows red in time with the heartbeat and the number turns red.
At 0 HP the red edge stays lit, the content desaturates and darkens, the label reads «Без сознания» and the death saves pulse; healing above 0 flashes the HP card green and restores colour.
Temporary HP get their own effects, as HP do.
Temporary HP read as an energy shield: the band's stripes keep running and the band glows blue; a shield icon sits beside the number.
While temporary HP last, the HP card hums with a slow blue aura, on its own calm rhythm rather than the heartbeat.
Gaining temporary HP sweeps a blue wave over the card, floats +N врем. and throws a few glints from the band.
Damage absorbed by temporary HP flashes the band and throws blue shards; losing the last temporary HP breaks the shield: a larger burst of shards, a flash and the aura fades.

Looping effects here (the flowing highlight, the heartbeat, the temporary HP aura) run only at the «Все» motion level and only in the front actor window; reactive effects (ghost, glow, shards, floating numbers) run at «Все» and «Сдержанно».

Shows one die per hit die. Click rolls a die through dnd5e (actor.rollHitDie): the die spins, the roll shows beside it (к6: 3 + 2) and HP rise by the result. No die is given back by hand: rests restore them. With no dice left the track shakes.
Rests return hit dice as dnd5e decides (actor.initiateRest); the track only shows the result, the returned dice popping back in.
Shows the roll formula: hit die plus Constitution modifier.
Shows one rune per spell slot, grouped by circle; spent runes are hollow.
Click opens the Spells tab.
Intact runes and slot gems glint one at a time, at random, about every 2 seconds.
Visible only at 0 HP; click the n-th mark to set that many successes or failures, click the last set mark to remove it.

A «Бросить спасбросок от смерти» button rolls through dnd5e (actor.rollDeathSave): 10 or more is a success, less a failure, 1 counts two failures, 20 brings the character back with 1 HP. The result shows beside the button; after three successes or three failures the button hides.
Marking a success throws green sparks; marking a failure throws red sparks and shakes the block.
Three successes turn the block green with «Стабилизирована»; three failures dim it with «Погибла».
Shows AC, initiative, speed and proficiency bonus as read-only values; initiative rolls on click.
AC shows its breakdown (base, Dexterity, items, effects) on hover.
Right click on AC, initiative or speed opens the dnd5e dialog for it (ArmorClassConfig, InitiativeConfig, MovementSensesConfig) for the owner and the GM.
Click toggles heroic inspiration; turning it on pops the chip once.
While on, the chip glows gold, a sheen passes across it every few seconds and its star turns slowly; turning it on throws golden sparks.
Click adds one exhaustion level, right click removes one. The number of pips comes from dnd5e's exhaustion config (six by default); lit pips are the current level.

Appears with a pop when a concentration spell is cast and names the spell. Click on the name rolls a concentration save through dnd5e (actor.rollConcentration) and shows the roll beside it; the cross ends concentration (actor.endConcentration) and the badge leaves.
Casting another concentration spell replaces the named spell.
While concentrating, the eye in the badge blinks now and then.
Lists starred items, spells and features in the order they were starred; a new favorite slides in with a pop, a removed one leaves and the rest close the gap.
Click a favorite opens its tab and selects it.
When empty, shows a hint to star items and spells.
Groups favorites by action cost: Действие, Бонусное действие, Реакция, Прочее; empty groups hide.
Shows the tile, name and a short meta: quantity for items, circle for spells.
Shows the attack bonus or save DC and damage under the name, and on the right the slot circle as runes for spells or the quantity for items.
On hover a quick action slides in on the right: cast for a spell, use for an item.
Shows the level orb, name, class, subclass, species and background; the six abilities sit under it. There is no separate XP bar.
Click rolls an ability check (actor.rollAbilityCheck), Shift+click rolls the saving throw (actor.rollSavingThrow); a filled dot marks saving throw proficiency.
On hover the score slides away and the saving throw bonus («Спас +N») slides in.
Short rest opens the dnd5e short rest dialog.
Long rest goes through dnd5e (actor.initiateRest), which decides what returns; the sheet animates the result: restored runes and pips pop back in one after another, 70 ms apart.
A long rest first lets night fall over the sheet, then a warm dawn, and only then do the resources refill.
Opens the settings drawer from the right over a scrim; Escape or the scrim closes it.
In the header it shrinks the window to 320 px, which switches to the compact layout; in the compact rail it expands back to the previous width, at least 1040 px.
Tabs: Обзор, Снаряжение, Заклинания, Умения, Заметки; Обзор, Умения and Заметки can be hidden in settings.
The underline slides to the chosen tab over 420 ms; the new panel fades in from 8 px below.
Click shows its panel; counts show the number of items, spells or features.
Shows skills, saving throws, passive senses and proficiencies as cards that wrap by width.
Lists the 18 skills with ability, proficiency mark (hollow, filled, ringed for expertise) and total bonus.
Click rolls the skill check (actor.rollSkill).
Lists the six saving throws with proficiency and total bonus.
Click rolls the saving throw (actor.rollSavingThrow).
Shows passive scores, senses, proficiencies and languages; values are not edited in place, the card's gear opens the dnd5e dialogs.
Also lists armor proficiencies; tools have their own card.

Shows the purse, load, the paperdoll, the containers and the inventory in sections by dnd5e item type (Оружие, Снаряжение, Расходуемое, Инструменты, Добыча); items inside a container are not repeated in the sections. The doll sits left of the inventory when the tab is at least 700 px wide, otherwise centred above it.
Holds search, the sort select, the Экипировано and Настроено filter chips, the view switch, the trade button and the doll toggle.
Filters the tab's lists by name as you type; empty sections say nothing was found.
Switches the tab's lists between list, cards and icons only; each tab remembers its own choice.
Entries glide from their old place to the new one when the view changes.
Icons-only shows only tiles; the name shows on hover, a dot marks equipped items and a number marks a spell's circle.
Shows or hides the paperdoll; the inventory glides to fill the space.
Uses a figure icon; the hand icon is reserved for equip.

Shows pp, gp, ep, sp and cp and the total value in gold; with Item Piles active its currencies and its total are shown instead. Click a coin (owner, GM) to edit: −5 spends, +10 adds, 20 sets (actor.update on system.currency).
When a total changes it counts to the new value and its coin flips once.
Shows carried weight against capacity as text and a bar.

Thresholds come from dnd5e's system.attributes.encumbrance (world rule, size, Powerful Build, effects; Weighty Containers' reductions through its integration); stops are marked on the bar, which is green, amber past encumbered and red past heavily encumbered; crossing a stop shakes it once. Hidden when the world uses no encumbrance.

Shows the preset's figure (humanoid, four-legged beast, wagon, ship or airship) with up to twelve slots in two columns beside it: the first half of the preset's slots fills the left column top-down, the rest the right column bottom-aligned, so the main hand and the off hand face each other on the bottom row.
With the world setting showActorPortraitBackdrop on, the actor's portrait shows faintly behind the figure.

A filled slot shows the item's tile; click selects the item (details or inspector, as a row does). Unequip with the × that appears on hover or by dragging the tile out of the slot onto the list; the tile flies back to its row.
An empty slot equips the first unequipped item that fits; with none it shakes and says so.
While an item is dragged, the slots it fits glow; dropping it on one equips it through the equipment rules; dropping it on a slot it does not fit shakes the slot with the reason.
A landed item bounces the slot once.

Equipment rules (the module's rule engine): slot fit, one body armour, one shield, an occupied slot swaps its item back to its row; while a two-handed weapon is held the off-hand slot shows a lock and a faded copy of that weapon. Third-party rules (registerRule) apply too.

The world's enforcementMode decides a broken rule: block refuses with the reason (default), auto_swap clears what is in the way, warn allows it and says so. The same rules guard equips made from the vanilla sheet.
Up to three sockets sit centred under the figure between the main hand and off hand slots, with «Настройка N / max» under them.
The attunement limit is 0–9 (set in the preset editor); with more than three sockets the track moves to its own full-width strip under the doll.
In the strip, sockets form rows of at most five, centred.

A filled socket shows the attuned item; an empty one is a dashed ring. Attunement is independent of equipping: dropping an item on a socket attunes it, the × on a filled socket ends it. Past the limit a new attunement is refused with a shake; when a preset switch leaves more attuned items than the limit, the count turns red («4 / 3») and new attunements are refused until it drops.
Click the header to collapse or expand; the body animates its height.
Dropping an item on a section takes it out of its container; an item's type, and so its section, never changes by a drop.
In list view each row keeps its tags on one line and fades them out at the right edge, so rows keep one height.
Enter or Space toggles it from the keyboard.
Opens dnd5e's item creation for the section's type (Item.createDialog).
Click selects the row: in the wide layout the inspector shows it, otherwise its description opens under the row; clicking again deselects.
Owner and GM can drag a row to a doll slot, onto a container, or onto the list to take it out of its container.
Click on the item's tile uses it through dnd5e (item.use): dnd5e picks the activity, consumes quantity, charges or ammunition and rolls; click elsewhere on the row selects it.
The row shows weight, price, «Настроено» or «Требует настройки» for items needing attunement, and the item's tags.
Opens and closes with a height animation; never shown in the wide layout.

Equips the item to its first free fitting slot through the equipment rules and the tile flies to the doll, or unequips it and the tile flies back. Items with no fitting slot in the preset (Ioun stones, trinkets) are equipped without a slot.
Stars or unstars the entry; the rail list updates with a glide.
Opens the item's menu, as on the vanilla sheet: Просмотр, Изменить, Дублировать, Удалить (item.deleteDialog), В чат (item.displayCard), and Идентифицировать for unidentified items.
For spells the menu is Просмотр, Изменить, Дублировать, Удалить, В чат and Создать свиток (Item5e.createScrollFromSpell).
Shows slot tracks per circle, then a Подготовленные section, then the spellbook (Книга заклинаний) grouped by circle with cantrips first.
Подготовленные lists every prepared spell of circle 1 and higher, sorted by circle; cantrips are always ready and never listed there.
In the spellbook, unprepared spells are dimmed to 50%.
After the spellbook come Врождённые and По желанию, shown only when the actor has such spells; they need no slots.
Spell-school colours come from SC Rarity Colors when it is active (its spell-school-styles setting, including per-level variants), otherwise from the module's own school palette (--school-* tokens).
One row of slot gems per circle.
A warlock's pact slots get their own track «Договор · N круг» after the circles, and their own rune group in the rail (system.spells.pact).
Click a lit gem to spend slots down to it (it bursts), click a hollow one to restore up to it (it pops in).

Shows school, casting time, range, the components chip В / С / М (hover shows the material and its cost), К for concentration, Р for ritual and «Всегда» for always-prepared spells; innate spells show their uses as pips.
Shown for everything dnd5e can cast now: cantrips, prepared, always-prepared, innate, at-will and pact spells, and rituals; an unprepared non-ritual spell has none.

Casting calls item.use(): dnd5e's usage dialog chooses the slot, upcasting or ritual casting; the sheet reacts to what dnd5e spent — that gem bursts and sparks fly in the school's colour. The mock imitates the dialog's default (the lowest free slot of the circle or higher).
With nothing to spend dnd5e refuses: the row shakes and says why; an innate spell used up waits for a long rest.
A concentration spell sets the concentration badge.
Groups features by source: class, species, background.
Rows do not repeat the source their section is named after; tiles are tinted by source: class, species, background.
Shows the source, tags and uses.
Click a lit pip to spend uses down to it, a hollow one to restore up to it.
One free-text field for the player's notes.
Saves on blur.
Exists only in the wide layout; shows the selected entry's tile, name, rarity or circle, tags, description and its main action.
With nothing selected it shows a hint.
Settings are per user and apply at once: theme, accent, density, motion, rail blocks, visible tabs.
Ночь (dark) or Пергамент (light).
Six accents: латунь, угли, аркана, лес, иней, роза; the choice recolours every accent token.
Свободно: 44 px rows, 36 px tiles; Плотно: 34 px rows, 28 px tiles.
Все or Выключены.
Hides or shows each rail block; the rest glide to close the gap.
The rest buttons can be hidden too.
Hides or shows a tab; hiding the open tab switches to Снаряжение.
Mock only: switches the preview between owner, observer and GM.
Buttons −5, −1, +1, +5 apply that damage or healing with the same animations as the bar; only the GM sees them, players and observers never do.
The GM's shield button sets temporary HP to 8 when that is higher; temporary HP never stack, the higher value stays. The real button lets the GM enter the amount.
Shows the spellcasting ability, spell save DC, spell attack bonus and passive Perception; hidden for actors without spellcasting.
With several casting classes it shows one line per class: ability, save DC and attack bonus.
Lists active effects and conditions with a short effect line and the time left; concentration appears first while it lasts.
Click opens the effect; right click ends or removes it.
Opens the dnd5e conditions list to add a condition.
Shows prepared spells against the class limit from dnd5e, per casting class; amber at the limit, red past it.
Past the limit dnd5e only warns: the header shows its preparation warning («Подготовка 11 / 10»); nothing is refused.
Toggles whether the spell is prepared; the row glides into or out of Подготовленные.
Preparing past the limit is allowed, as in dnd5e: the counter turns red and shakes, and the header warns.
Spells the class always has prepared show no toggle.
Toggles on a row show their on state by colour only, without a filled box.
Click a filled socket to select its item (inspector in the wide layout, inline details otherwise).
Opens the trade panel; the built-in trading between players stays.
Shown to owners only; observers never see it, and the GM sees it only when a trade waits for GM recovery.
Keeps the current trading rules: requests go through user flags, one active GM coordinates, rechecks ownership and confirmations and moves the assets; the snapshot lives in a private journal.
Opens beside the inventory without a scrim, so items can be added while it is open.
One trade at a time per actor; the partner is another player's character whose owner is online.
In the standard and wide layouts the content steps aside while the panel is open, so the offer buttons on rows stay reachable.
Lists other players' characters as «Персонаж · игрок».
Sends the trade request; the panel switches to the two offers.
Says what the trade waits for: the partner's offer, confirmations, or the GM carrying it out; a reset of confirmations shakes it.
Changing either offer clears both confirmations.
Lists offered items with quantity steppers and four coin fields capped by the purse; partial stacks are allowed.
Read-only view of the partner's items and coins with their confirmation state.
− and + change the offered quantity between 0 and the stack; 0 removes it.
Shown on inventory rows while a trade is open; adds one of the item to the offer and the tile flies into the panel.
Both participants must confirm, a gift included; then the GM carries out the transfer.
Toggles your confirmation; an empty trade cannot be confirmed.
Received items arrive unequipped, unattuned and outside any container.
Cancels the trade for both sides.
Shows «Кукла» and the actor's preset name.
The GM picks a doll preset per actor; presets can have many more slots than the standard one.

Visible to the GM only; players see the preset name. Switching presets re-slots equipment (autoReconcileSlots): an item whose slot is gone moves to a free fitting slot of the new preset, or stays equipped in Без слота; slotless items take a fitting free slot when one appears. Attunement is never removed by a switch.
Standard presets: Стандарт 2024, Стандарт 2014, Зверь, Повозка, Корабль, Воздушное судно; the GM adds custom ones. A preset is a figure plus its slots; the default follows the actor type.
Opens the existing preset editor, where the GM builds custom presets.
GM only.
Slots that do not fit beside the figure overflow into this wrapping grid under it.
Twelve slots sit beside the figure; the rest go here at 52 px, as many per row as fit.
Shows the character level; the XP progress to the next level fills the orb as a liquid whose surface keeps moving.
The closer the next level, the stronger the orb glows.
Progress comes from dnd5e's prepared XP fields (system.details.xp.min, max and pct), so world rules apply.
Glow grows with the square of progress, so it stays faint early and builds near the level; from 90% the orb slowly pulses.
When XP changes the liquid rises or falls over 900 ms.
Hover shows level, current and next-level XP and the percentage; the same text is its accessible name.
With motion off the surface stands still and the orb does not pulse.
Characters using milestone levelling (XP hidden in dnd5e settings) get an orb with the level only, no liquid.
Small bubbles rise through the liquid; hover brightens the orb.

Click (owner or GM) opens the XP card under the orb: level, progress bar with current and next-level XP, quick +50, +100, +250, +1000, and a field with Добавить and Задать. Escape or a click outside closes it.
When XP reaches the next level, the orb grows, fills to the brim, glows gold, an arrow rises over it and the number reads 6→7; the card says «можно повысить — нажмите на сферу».
Click on the ready orb levels up through dnd5e (AdvancementManager.forLevelChange), which asks which class when there are several; right click or Shift+click still opens the XP card.
In milestone levelling (XP off in dnd5e settings) the orb shows only the level, without liquid or XP card; a click offers the level-up through the same dnd5e manager.
Observers see the orb and its hover text but cannot open the card or level up.
The pulse near the next level, the moving surface and the bubbles are ambient effects: «Все» motion level only, front window only.
Mock only: sets the progress to the next level to preview the fill and glow.
Short and long rest sit in the rail, labelled, right under HP, hit dice and spell slots, so players reach them without searching the header.
No rest durations on the buttons: each GM sets how long rests take. The short rest button shows the hit dice left; the long rest button lists what it restores.
Shown to the GM always and to owners only while dnd5e's allowRests setting is on; hidden for observers.
Casts the spell or uses the item straight from the rail, under the same rules as in its tab.
XP card of the level orb: XP is written through actor.update on system.details.xp.value; the card has no level-up button, the ready orb is the button.
Class, subclass, species and background in the header subtitle are links: click opens that item's dnd5e sheet.
«⋯» in the header opens a menu of rare entries; click outside or Escape closes it.
Открыть лист dnd5e — opens the vanilla sheet (actor.sheet.render).
Особые черты and Бастион open the vanilla sheet on that tab, since dnd5e 5.3.3 has no standalone dialog for them; Бастион shows only when bastions are on in the world.
Вернуть исходный облик shows only while the actor is transformed (actor.revertOriginalForm).
Overview card listing tool proficiencies with ability, proficiency mark and total bonus.
Click rolls the tool check through dnd5e (actor.rollToolCheck).
Overview card: damage resistances, immunities, vulnerabilities, condition immunities and damage modification, read from system.traits; empty entries read «нет».

Each Overview card shows a gear on hover for the owner and the GM; it opens the matching dnd5e dialog (SkillsConfig, AbilityConfig, ToolsConfig, DamagesConfig / TraitsConfig, MovementSensesConfig, LanguagesConfig, WeaponsConfig). Hidden for observers.
The item tile is a button: click uses the item (item.use).
On hover, − and + beside the quantity change it by one (item.update on system.quantity); hidden for observers.
Items with charges show them as pips instead of a quantity: click spends one, right click restores one (system.uses.spent).
Items that need attunement have their own attune toggle, independent of equipping; past the attunement limit it is refused with a shake of the row and the attunement track.
Sorts each section by name, weight, price, rarity or by hand (drag); each tab remembers its choice.
Экипировано and Настроено narrow the lists to equipped or attuned items; each tab remembers its filters.
Opens dnd5e's CurrencyManager to convert coins or transfer them to another actor or a container.
Containers are listed in their own section; each container row is followed by a tray of its contents, and a container inside another nests its own tray.

Each tray shows the load band and the weight reduction from Weighty Containers; the GM sees a gear that opens the Weighty Containers rules for that container. Without Weighty Containers the dnd5e capacity is shown.
Dropping an item on a tray puts it in that container; Weighty Containers validates it (capacity, its rules) and a refusal shakes the tray with the reason. A container can never go inside itself.

With more than three containers they start folded: a folded tray is one line with the load band and a peek of up to six content tiles plus +N; what the user unfolds is remembered; Свернуть все / Развернуть все sits in the section header.
While dragging, hovering a folded tray for about half a second unfolds it, so an item can reach any nested container.
Searching unfolds only the containers with matches, down to the nested one, and hides the rest; clearing the search restores the folding.
GM only: opens the Weighty Containers rules window for the container.

Something dragged in from outside the window (compendium, sidebar, chat, another actor) outlines the Снаряжение tab with «Отпустите, чтобы добавить»; what happens on the drop is settled in «Перенос предметов извне в окно актора: решение».
Items equipped without a slot show as chips under the doll in «Без слота»; click selects, the × unequips.
Подготовленные, Ритуал, Концентрация, Действие, Бонусное and Реакция narrow the spell lists; they combine.
Pact slot pips work like circle pips: click a lit one to spend down to it, a hollow one to restore up to it; a long rest refills them (dnd5e decides, the mock imitates).
Header chip shown while prepared spells exceed a class limit; it mirrors dnd5e's preparation warning.
